Executive Leadership Vacancy Announced

The American India Foundation (AIF) has announced an open recruitment process for a Chief Finance and Operating Officer (CFOO) to join its leadership team in New Delhi, India. According to an official announcement shared by organization representatives, the appointment comes as AIF initiates an ambitious phase of institutional growth and organizational transformation.

The organization describes the position as extending beyond traditional administrative duties. The incoming CFOO is expected to provide strategic direction across multiple institutional domains, including finance, operations, governance, risk management, compliance, technology, and digital transformation. The role involves close collaboration with the Country Director and the broader senior leadership team to build and strengthen AIF's institutional architecture.

Role Requirements and Location

  • Employer: American India Foundation (AIF)
  • Role: Chief Finance and Operating Officer (CFOO)
  • Location: New Delhi, India
  • Eligibility: The organization seeks leaders with strong financial and governance expertise, experience in managing complex organizations, and a proven ability to lead change at scale. Specific educational credentials, years of experience, and citizenship requirements are not detailed in the public announcement.
  • Salary: Not specified
  • Deadline: Not specified
  • Selection Process: Not specified
  • Application Steps: Interested candidates are directed to review the full job description and submit applications through the official portal provided by the organization.
  • Official Application Link: AIF Job Description and Application Portal
